statusPolicy: A capability is enabled only after provider-specific SQL translation and database runtime tests pass. Source presence and test definitions are not passing evidence.

milestones.name: Real integration harness
milestones.exitGate: Real provider and database tests pass; no API stubs.

milestones.name: Scalar query and predicate parity
milestones.exitGate: SQL and runtime results match the semantic oracle for every enabled scalar operator.

milestones.name: Authorization, projection, and relationship traversal
milestones.exitGate: Cross-tenant and child-authorization tests pass against PostgreSQL.

milestones.name: Relationship quantifiers and aggregate filters
scope: authorized COUNT MIN MAX correlated scalar subqueries
milestones.exitGate: SQL and runtime tests pass on H2 and PostgreSQL; unsupported shapes fail closed.

milestones.name: Aggregate ordering and private slots
scope: authorized one-hop COUNT MIN MAX ordering
private tuple slots excluded from semantic projection
JPA fetch-request continuation tuple compiled against exact correlated aggregate ORDER BY expressions with typed bindings (Step 58)
milestones.exitGate: Canonical typed cursor values and lexicographic continuation predicates compile to provider SQL and pass multi-page authorization, tie, null, and dialect runtime tests; semantic cursor decode and plan identity integration remain required.

milestones.name: Canonical keyset and aggregate cursor parity
scope: typed aggregate cursor decoding and NULLS LAST lexicographic continuation descriptors (Step 53)
private aggregate cursor pipeline joins JPA/in-memory tuple slots to plan-bound cursors with typed primary-key tie-breakers (Step 57)
milestones.exitGate: Canonical typed cursor values and lexicographic continuation predicates compile to provider SQL and pass multi-page authorization, tie, null, and dialect runtime tests.
implemented: ordered cursor tuple pipeline supports interleaved aggregate and ordinary keys (Step 59)

milestones.name: Mutation and transaction parity
milestones.exitGate: Atomicity, caller transaction ownership, version conflicts, and rollback pass against a real DB.

milestones.name: Dialect and implementation matrix
milestones.exitGate: Every certified capability is tied to exact implementation and database versions.

milestones.name: Java Native Image readiness
milestones.exitGate: Exact JPA implementation builds and runs a native image with semantic success evidence.

milestones.name: Operational hardening and release certification
milestones.exitGate: All mandatory security, runtime, dialect, and evidence gates pass.

nativeImagePolicy: Separate from JVM certification; certify exact JPA implementation and version only.
releaseGate: No capability is advertised as supported until all applicable exit gates and security tests pass.

latestIncrement.summary: Added H2 and PostgreSQL integration tests that keep a repeatable-read JpaOrmSnapshotPageSession open while a separate transaction changes child aggregate values; continuation pages must preserve the original snapshot ordering without duplicates or omissions. H2 and PostgreSQL runtime execution remains unverified pending Java 27 CI.
